facts.title: Ayot St. Lawrence and Kimpton
facts.summary: A circuit between two Hertfordshire villages, crossing meadows and woodland and visiting Ayot St. Lawrence, where George Bernard Shaw lived.
facts.parking_note: The guide identifies roadside parking on Kimpton High Street (SG4 8PT).

facts.title: Broxbourne Circular
facts.summary: A long circuit from Broxbourne Station that follows a canal before climbing into Broxbourne Woods National Nature Reserve. The distance is for the main route.

facts.title: Tring winter walk
facts.summary: A winter circuit from Tring town centre through Tring Park, with beech woodland and views towards the Vale of Aylesbury.
